en:
No change in this edition's pages: build 1090 brings the demonstrations up to date with builds 1082 to 1089, and in
their Guidebook places the Projects chapter in Your projects (it had fallen into a tenth section of its own).
web: This demonstration now carries builds 1082 to 1089: Tabula prints in colour and keeps paragraphs and bullet points in good order, the five rooms speak French throughout, the Writing Rooms each have a face of their own, and the Guidebook stands in nine sections with a search and a short guided tour; the Projects chapter is in Your projects.
